title: FLAIM: AIM-based synthetic data generation in the federated setting
summary: Research code accompanying a KDD 2024 paper studying AIM-based differentially private synthetic data generation in federated settings, benchmarking federated CTGAN and other generators against non-IID client partitions. SDV's dataset-download API (sdv.datasets.demo) is imported and called to fetch demo datasets used alongside PMLB data for the experiments.
needs: Affiliations of the three named authors are not stated in the harvested README text; only used for demo dataset downloads, not core synthesis (which relies on snsynth's CTGAN, not sdv.tabular).
